title: Ng Ziang Kaung

page_data.en:
C. I. D.
S. O. REG
No. 777
Date 19/12/16

Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

December 18th 1916.

Sir,
It is reported that the leading residents of
Ng Ziang Kaung 引翔港 are considering the advisability
of approaching the Municipal Council with a view
to erecting a market under Municipal control there.
About eighty of the Shanghai dye workers
held a meeting in their Guild in the City on the
17th inst at which it was decided to demand
an increase in wages. No date was fixed for
announcing their decision to the employers.
Liang Chi Chao 梁启超 entertained the City gentry
and leading business men at Hardoon's garden on
the 17th inst.
Yang Zung Tsz 楊潤之 the former interpreter
to the Mixed Court Magistrates has received special
permission from the Ministry of Justice to practice
law in the interior.
The band of so called rebels under Lieu Foh Sung 劉福勝
have not yet received passage tickets from General
Li whose secretary told them on the 17th inst that
if they wanted tickets now they would have to apply
to the C.S.P. Another letter on the subject to
the C.S.P. was written by Lieu on the 17th inst.

Your Obedient Servant,

mmmmmusten(

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

a+1
19/-
page_data.zh:
刑事侦缉处
特别办公室登记
第 777 号
日期 1916年12月19日

上海工部局。

（印章：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探科）

1916年12月18日。

先生：

据报，引翔港 (Ng Ziang Kaung) 的主要居民正在考虑是否适宜向工部局提出请求，以便在该地建造一处由工部局管理的市场。

约八十名上海染坊工人于本月17日在城内的行会举行会议，决定要求增加工资。尚未确定向雇主宣布此决定的日期。

梁启超 (Liang Chi Chao) 于本月17日在哈同花园宴请了城内士绅及商界领袖。

前会审公廨译员杨润之 (Yang Zung Tsz) 已获得司法部特别许可，在内地从事律师职业。

刘福胜 (Lieu Foh Sung) 麾下所谓的叛乱团伙尚未从李将军处获得船票；李将军的秘书于本月17日告知他们，若现在需要船票，必须向江苏巡按使署 (C.S.P.) 申请。刘福胜于本月17日就此事宜又致函江苏巡按使署一封。

您顺从的仆人，

mmmmmusten(

首席侦探督察。

警务处总监。

a+1
19/-
